reviews.title: Feeling a bit scammed
reviews.text: So I used to love this app and happily paid for a lifetime subscription which one would assume that includes future updates because that’s a pretty normal thing. However it seems that they’ve upgraded their scanner and my lifetime subscription isn’t good enough to use it. So I reached out to support and got no response. If you are planning to buy the lifetime please be aware that it most likely does not include future updates.

reviews.title: Been using for years
reviews.text: Definitely a simple app, sometimes so simple it’s frustrating but I’ve saved so many foods and such it’s fine. My only complaint is recently I will run out of calories before I hit all of my fat, carbs, or protein. How is this possible? There needs to be something that lines up the correct calories per however many grams of fat/carbs/protein is entered in a recipe or something. Being 200 over calories but still having fat/carbs/and protein is says I still need to hit for the day is throwing me way off.

reviews.title: Give it a try
reviews.text: The app is great and the support team is amazing! You can use the app without buying premium and it has the option to buy a lifetime membership for the premium features! It’s 100%worth it. Just want to shout out Joan A. From the support team. They were very helpful and got my problems resolved very quickly and painlessly. Overall I like this app better than MFP

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Purchased the pro version years ago.  Returned to start using the app again, but now I have to pay for a subscription if I want to use all the features that I already paid to use.  Should have grandfathered in people who had already purchased the app.

reviews.title: Great but has issues
reviews.text: All was well until one day, the app just broke. Now even with the paid version I’m completely unable to use it :/ hopefully this gets addressed but until then proceed with caution

reviews.title: The secret to my 20lb weight loss
reviews.text: I’ve literally never written an app review before lol. But this app is truly the reason I was able to lose 20 lbs this year and so I am really so grateful for it. It’s truly incredibly simple to use and not overwhelming or over complicated at all. Thank you to whoever made this app you’re a lifesaver!!

reviews.title: AI update
reviews.text: Incorporating “AI” into this app didn’t really do much except mess up existing food data and bog down the app. Longer load times, errors in existing custom foods/meals, and no real benefit except ai generated images for custom foods. App was 5 stars prior to this update. Not sure what the end goal is here, but if I wanted to use AI for tracking id be doing everything for free on a dedicated ai app

The AI feature is not as good as other platforms, and if I can’t get my data back, I’m going somewhere else to track my Macros. Can’t wait until the price hike comes because they added AI and removed the main reason I used their product.

reviews.title: Something changed
reviews.text: Been using this app for a while now and would’ve rated it 5 stars before. Recently in the past few weeks i’ve noticed the ads a little more. Before they were annoying as all ads are, but now they’re appearing more often and for longer. I get that the bag needs to be secured but the ads are getting a bit much. “Oh just pay for the plus version.” I’m broke. If I can’t find a better app that has a lifetime plus version i’ll pay the price. But as a long term free user, my rating stands.

reviews.title: Great app for non- dieting
reviews.text:
It’s a simple to use, has everything you need, and doesn’t have so much extra stuff that it makes it overwhelming. Never crashes. And the developers are responsive to feedback.
What I really love is that it doesn’t constantly push weight loss goals on you- unless you go to a specific tab. I use it just for macro tracking to improve how I feel, with a non dieting approach.

reviews.title: Loving it! Tip below for health integration
reviews.text:
I’ve been loving this app. It’s easy to use, useful, and not filled with bloatware. I was trying to integrate my Apple health / workout info and finally found it! 
Menu > Settings > nutrition Settings > Exercise Frequency > choose “import from Apple health”.

reviews.title: This app changed my life in 6 months
reviews.text: At the start of January of 2025 I started the year with an intention of following through with on achieving my dream physique. I have never missed a day because this app make tracking bearable, I’ve tried MyFitnessPal, RP Coach and all these other apps and non of them can compare to SSMT if your looking for simplicity, I can honestly say this app will be the one for you. I’m already 54lbs down (246) and 11 from reaching my goals weight (235). I don’t know what made me wanna leave this review but I’m honestly glad that I got to share what I was feeling and how this helped me. And hope anybody reading this knows that achieving your dream is possible with consistency/discipline.

You’re better off using the notes app on your phone and using AI to check your macros.

reviews.title: Something changed
reviews.text: I loved this app for the longest but the last few updates have been nothing but bugs and seems to make the app less simple and responsive. They added up to 8 meals a day but even after restarting the app multiple times, the search feature wouldn’t recognize foods. I’m also no longer able to correctly adjust a serving size on the fly and now it’s a lengthy process which doesn’t always save so I’m having to redo it multiple times. It was an intuitive and simple app to use but they’re quickly going away from their own standards of stupid simple and creating something that’s a lesser version of other available apps available on the market.
